
  // v_const_from_any
  public static func v_const_from_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_const {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_const = type_any.p_const
    return output
  }

  // v_empty
  public static func v_empty(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = type_type.p_empty
    return output
  }

  // v_empty_from_any
  public static func v_empty_from_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = type_any.p_type
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = type_type.p_empty
    return output
  }

  // v_global_register_from_pathn_listtype_listconst
  public static func v_global_register_from_pathn_listtype_listconst(
    _ pathn : String,
    _ listtype : [Vx_Core.Type_type],
    _ listany : [Vx_Core.Type_any]
  ) -> Bool {
    var listkey : [String] = []
    var listconstany : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = []
    var listconst : [Vx_Core.Type_const] = []
    for type_any in listany {
      let type_const : Vx_Core.Type_const = Vx_Core.v_const_from_any(
        type_any)
      if type_const !== Vx_Core.e_const {
        let namen : String = type_const.p_name
        listkey.append(namen)
        listconstany.append(type_any)
        listconst.append(type_const)
      }
    }
    let anymap : Vx_Core.Type_anymap = Vx_Core.v_anymap_from_listkey_listany(
      listkey,
      listconstany)
    let constmap : Vx_Core.Type_constmap = Vx_Core.v_constmap_from_listconst(
      listconst)
    let typemap : Vx_Core.Type_typemap = Vx_Core.v_typemap_from_listtype(
      listtype)
    var type_package : Vx_Core.Type_package = Vx_Core.v_create_package()
    type_package.p_path = pathn
    type_package.p_anymap = Vx_Core.v_reserve_anymap(
      anymap)
    type_package.p_constmap = Vx_Core.v_reserve_constmap(
      constmap)
    type_package.p_typemap = Vx_Core.v_reserve_typemap(
      typemap)
    var type_project : Vx_Core.Type_project = g_global.p_project
    let type_packagemap : Vx_Core.Type_packagemap = type_project.p_packagemap
    type_project.p_packagemap = Vx_Core.v_replace_packagemap(
      type_packagemap,
      Vx_Core.v_copy_packagemap(
        type_packagemap,
        Vx_Core.v_anylist_from_listany(
          [
            Vx_Core.a_string_cast_stringn(
              pathn),
            type_package.p_any
          ])))
    let output : Bool = true
    return output
  }

  // v_type_t_startup
  public static func v_type_t_startup(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ pkgnamen : String,
    _ namen : String,
    _ aliasn : String,
    _ extends_string : Vx_Core.Type_string,
    _ empty_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_type(
      type_type)
    var pathn : String = ""
    switch pkgnamen {
    case "":
      pathn = namen
    default:
      pathn = pkgnamen +
        "/" +
        namen
    }
    type_type.p_path = pathn
    type_type.p_pkgname = pkgnamen
    type_type.p_name = namen
    type_type.p_alias = aliasn
    type_type.p_extends = extends_string
    type_type.p_empty = empty_any
    var type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      type_type,
      type_type)
    type_any.p_const = Vx_Core.v_const_from_type(
      type_type)
    type_type.p_any = type_any
    empty_any.p_const = Vx_Core.v_const_empty(
      type_type)
  }
